statement: Pay down the accepted debt the goal and cursor plugins carry from their final reviews: goal-plugin input/state hardening that was documented-not-built, and the cursor roster probe's duplicated spawn-plan construction. Two real increments; crossing the retro's 5-disposition floor is a side effect, never the goal.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every item merged or explicitly dropped with a reason; dispositions recorded from reconciled PR state, with start called before work begins

backlog.title: Goal plugin: build the documented-not-built hardening (private state dir, strict flags, timestamp types, honest timeout suffix)
backlog.detail: Four accepted-debt items from the goal plugin's final review, one coherent hardening pass. (1) ledger.mjs stateDir was 'documented, not built': mirror the sibling plugins' private-dir doctrine goal-locally (recursive-create the root then validate it, non-recursive mkdir at the leaf so a pre-planted symlink fails EEXIST instead of being followed, lstat symlink refusal, 0o700 with POSIX mode/ownership checks gated off win32) — unattended runs are now documented, so free-text notes in a world-readable tmpdir deserve the sibling treatment; update the ledger.mjs comment and the spec line that called this the known upgrade. (2) args.mjs silently passes unknown short flags (-x) to positionals; refuse any token starting with '-' that is not a known option, keeping -C working. (3) validateGoal allows createdAt/updatedAt of any type; when present they must be date-parseable strings, errors naming the field. (4) handleCheck appends 'its processes may still be running' to ANY spawn error detail; scope it to timeout errors (ETIMEDOUT/timed out), since an EACCES never left processes behind. Tests for each behavior in the goal suites.

disposition.notes: Implemented by a Claude subagent; slug-pattern interaction found in its review closed at the validation layer

backlog.title: Cursor: stop duplicating the spawn-plan line construction in the roster probe
backlog.detail: Open issue from the model-roster-pins review: probeCursorModelRoster in cursor-companion.mjs replays cursor.mjs's non-cmd-shim command-line construction (file + prefix + args) by hand because planCommandLine is not exported — a lockstep hazard where a future plan-shape change in cursor.mjs silently breaks the probe. Export the plan-line builder from cursor.mjs (provider-only module, no chassis mirroring) and make the probe consume it, deleting the duplicated construction. cursor-doctor and cursor-runtime suites must stay green; the roster integration test (node-script twin) is the behavioral pin.
